description: This Java class 'Histograms' provides functionality for collecting, managing, and reporting statistical histograms and performance metrics, including methods for adding data points, generating snapshots, and formatting statistical reports.

classes.name: Histograms
classes.description: Main class for managing histograms and statistical data collection.

classes.name: Histograms.LocalStats
classes.description: Holds local statistical data for thread-specific aggregation.

classes.name: Histograms.Statistics
classes.description: Represents performance statistics for individual operations, including histogram data.

classes.name: Histograms.StatisticsGroup
classes.description: Groups multiple statistics of the same type, allowing aggregation.

classes.name: Histograms.ValueType
classes.description: Enumerates different types of values, currently only 'INVOCATION'.

methods.name: dumpStats
methods.description: Updates total statistics and resets snapshot, returning formatted statistics as list of strings.

methods.name: getCurrentStatistics
methods.description: Returns current histogram statistics without resetting state.

methods.name: sortAndAddTimes
methods.description: Sorts statistics groups and adds timing information for reporting.

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Calculates histogram index for a given value.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a data point to the histogram for a specific value type and name.

methods.name: getCurrentSnapshot
methods.description: Returns current statistics snapshot without resetting.

methods.name: takeAndResetSnapshot
methods.description: Returns snapshot of all gathered statistics and clears them.

methods.name: mergeStats
methods.description: Merges source statistics into a snapshot.

methods.name: sortStatistics
methods.description: Sorts statistics within a group for reporting.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a double value into a string buffer with appropriate precision.

methods.name: appendHeader
methods.description: Appends header information for a statistics group for logging.

methods.name: appendStatistics
methods.description: Appends detailed statistics for a group or individual statistic.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Formats a statistics group into a string for reporting.
